- src/payments — retry batching mixes timeout handling with backoff math and already re-sent duplicate charges.
- src/sync — ledger pagination is owned by one author and already shipped a page-skipping bug.

  - [5269882](https://github.com/acme/widgets/commit/5269882bf99baed4443572de72d77017b2ee4049) 2026-08-05 feat(billing): support credit notes

  - [bbb5742](https://github.com/acme/widgets/commit/bbb5742b8f0bf048257e67cfdf20d83636e31040) 2026-09-10 feat(payments): configurable batch size
